subject: Azure Marketplace private offer — procurement timeline & billing runbook
messages:
From: Elena Mendoza <elena.mendoza@civichealth.org>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Azure private offer — MAP & timeline request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Civic Health's engineering and security teams were impressed with the latency profile for your LLM runtime. Procurement asked me to start a mutual action plan so we can close a private offer through the Azure Marketplace. We have an internal target of getting committed in the next 4 weeks (target PO week of Aug 9) to align with our Q3 rollout.

Key asks from our side: 
- A MAP with milestone owners and dates (technical eval, security questionnaire, legal redline, PO issuance, Azure acceptance)
- A commercial quote that maps to the private offer SKU and billing path (do we bill via Azure Marketplace or direct invoicing? we prefer Marketplace billing)
- Any required attestation for data residency and PO terms (SOC2 evidence, data retention, IP terms)

Attached is our procurement template (just the fields we need filled). Can you send a draft MAP and the quote by EOD tomorrow? Also please include the expected step where AWS/Azure acceptance happens and whether DocuSign or Azure PO workflow is required.

Elena
Elena Mendoza
Head of Procurement, Civic Health
procurements@civichealth.org
Attachment: CivicHealth_Procurement_Template_2027-07-14.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mendoza <elena.mendoza@civichealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — MAP & timeline request

Hi Elena — great to hear Civic Health liked the demo. Thanks for the template.

I'm looping in Marissa (our Marketplace lead) and Karthik (procurement & billing) to help get you a rock-solid MAP and quote. Quick summary of our recommended flow (will send full MAP as an attachment):

1) Technical acceptance (Civic devs sign off on perf benchmarks) — target: 3 business days after you enable the eval account
2) Security & SOC2 evidence — target: 5 business days for our standard packet; we can expedite if needed
3) Legal review / commercial redlines — target: 7 business days (we accept DocuSign or Azure PO redline workflows)
4) PO issuance from Civic Health to Redwood or Azure Marketplace private offer acceptance (depending on billing path) — target: 3 business days after contract sign
5) Azure Marketplace acceptance & billing activation — target: 2 business days after PO submission to Azure

Billing paths: 
- Preferred (Marketplace billing): Customer issues PO to Azure Marketplace private offer; Azure handles invoicing & payment to Redwood. This keeps your finance reconciliation within Azure.
- Alternate (Direct invoice): Customer issues PO to Redwood; Redwood invoices direct and provides monthly consolidated statements. This path sometimes requires an additional commercial onboarding step with account services.

Attached: draft MAP (spreadsheet), and an initial private-offer quote mapped to the Azure SKU. Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm SLA/discount tiers and whether the Azure acceptance step requires a Marketplace listing update or just the private-offer acceptance?

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-azure-private-offer-quote-CH-4721-2027-07-14.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — MAP & timeline request

Jordan / Karthik — quick internal notes before we finalize the MAP for Civic Health: 

- Azure acceptance: For a private offer we submit the offer and the customer accepts it via Azure portal. The Marketplace team then marks the private offer accepted; no listing change required. Typically 24-48 hours once Azure receives the PO and the private-offer acceptance record is uploaded.
- Billing: If Civic wants Marketplace billing, we need the PO to reference the private-offer ID and include invoice receiver details. Karthik: confirm whether accounting needs a signed contract in addition to the PO for Marketplace payouts.
- SLA/discount: For CH-sized commitment, we can offer standard enterprise tiers: 3% discount at $50k commit / month; 7% for $100k+ commit. I'll add an optional burst clause for Q4 usage spikes.

Action items for the MAP doc I'm preparing:
- Owner columns (Redwood contact + Civic contact)
- Estimated days per milestone (business days)
- Dependencies (security review, legal redlines)
- Acceptance criteria for 'Technical acceptance' (benchmarks + smoke test)

I'll push the MAP as XLSX to you both and to Elena after Karthik confirms the billing nuance.

-marissa
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (internal) marketplace-offer-ops-checklist.xlsx
From: Elena Mendoza <elena.mendoza@civichealth.org>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@civichealth.org
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — MAP & timeline request

Thanks Jordan and Marissa — that flow looks good. A couple clarifications from our finance team: 

- We will use Marketplace billing if the private-offer process is straightforward; we prefer a single invoice through Azure.
- Our PO will include the private-offer ID; finance requests the vendor (Redwood) tax ID on the PO — can you confirm the TIN and mailing address to include?
- For SOC2 evidence, we'd appreciate a short attestation PDF with the control scope and last audit date.

We can target the following compressed timeline, pending no legal roadblocks: 
- Technical eval: Jul 20 - Jul 22 (Civic devs)
- Security review: Jul 23 - Jul 27 (we'll run the questionnaire and expect evidence)
- Legal redlines & sign: Jul 28 - Aug 2
- PO issued (Marketplace): Aug 3
- Azure acceptance & billing live: Aug 5-6

If you can send the vendor TIN and attestation by tomorrow (Jul 20), we'll move forward with the technical eval immediately.

Elena
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mendoza <elena.mendoza@civichealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — MAP & timeline request

Elena — thanks, executing the compressed timeline. Answers below and attachments included.

- Redwood vendor details for PO:
  Vendor name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Tax ID (TIN/EIN): 38-4719203
  Remit address: 600 Market St, 12th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94104

- SOC2 attestation: attached (PDF) with last audit date and scope.

Next steps we completed today:
- Sent MAP XLSX with milestone owners + dates (see MAP attachment)
- Submitted private-offer draft to Azure marketplace (pending your acceptance step) — private-offer ID: AZ-PO-CH-8729
- Submitted initial SR ticket with Azure for expedited acceptance (ref: AZ-TICKET-99214)

Attachments: redwood-azure-private-offer-quote-CH-4721-2027-07-14.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2027-07-20.pdf, MAP_CH-4721_v1.xlsx

We'll stand by for your technical evaluation notes and the PO when you're ready. If Civic prefers DocuSign for the agreement, we can send that link and route to your legal team; otherwise the PO + private-offer acceptance through Azure is sufficient.

Best,
Jordan
